description: This file defines classes related to tensor expression analysis, IR printing, and code generation for the Block backend in PyTorch's JIT tensor expression framework.

classes.name: BlockAnalysis
classes.description: Analyzes tensor programs for the Block backend, providing methods to check buffer targets, retrieve buffer info, and manage buffer mappings.

classes.name: BlockPrinter
classes.description: Overrides IRPrinter to produce Block-specific tensor code, including printing tensor info, arguments, buffers, and loops.

classes.name: BlockCodeGen
classes.description: Generates code for tensor programs using the Block backend, managing code text output, function naming, and code execution.

methods.name: is_buf_store_target
methods.description: Checks if a buffer is a target for store operations.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Returns the set of buffers loaded.

methods.name: stores
methods.description: Returns the set of buffers stored.

methods.name: block_size
methods.description: Returns the block size used in analysis.

methods.name: areBufsInMap
methods.description: Checks if given buffers are in the buffer map.

methods.name: getMultiDimBuf
methods.description: Retrieves a multi-dimensional buffer corresponding to a given buffer.

methods.name: getInputName
methods.description: Gets the input name for a buffer.

methods.name: getFlatInputName
methods.description: Gets the flattened input name for a buffer.

methods.name: getBufferMap
methods.description: Returns the mapping of input names to buffers.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Visitor methods for IR nodes: Store, Load, For, Block, Add, Mul.

methods.name: PrintTensorInfo
methods.description: Prints tensor information during IR printing.

methods.name: GetUniqueFuncName
methods.description: Generates a unique function name based on a prefix.
